title: Hydrogen sulfide in three dimensions
hook: Turn a model of H₂S and examine its shape.

knows: Atoms or cells can be represented with simplified models.
doesNotKnow: Sulfur has two bonding regions and two lone pairs. The positions of the atoms form a bent shape; the drawing is a model, not an angle measurement.

misconception: A familiar diagram automatically reveals the structure or function.
objective: Sulfur has two bonding regions and two lone pairs. The positions of the atoms form a bent shape; the drawing is a model, not an angle measurement.
